### About me
I studied Chemistry at ETH Zurich and completed my doctoral studies in the group of Prof. Christophe Coperet on understanding heterogeneous catalysts by combining synthetic, spectroscopic and computational methods. Afterwards I worked in the group of Prof. Erwin Reisner at the University of Cambridge UK, developing electro-​ and photocatalytic approaches to valorize waste chemicals. I work at Swiss CAT+ at ETH Zurich as a Senior Scientist focusing on accelerating catalyst discovery by combining data science, AI, automation and high-throughput experimentation.
